Paul provocatively tells the Corinthians, 'You have begun to reign — and without us!' (1 Cor 4:8). In Revelation, the saints will reign with Christ (Rev 20:4, 6). Spanish 'reinar' and French 'régner' are precise cognate equivalents, while the breadth of usage — from political to cosmic sovereignty — makes this one of the New Testament's most theologically loaded verbs."

Spanish 'reinar...

Spanish 'que reinan' and English 'being kings' capture the shift from verbal action to nominal designation.
